What we believe

## Four principles, _etched into_  every product decision.

01

### Connection over configuration.

Healthcare doesn't have a software problem. It has an integration problem. We did the EHR work so everyone else doesn't have to.

02

### Workflow is the only thing.

If it lives outside the chart, it doesn't exist. We mesh into the workflow the doctor already has — and disappear into it.

03

### Trust is the product.

No PHI training. Audit trail on everything. Human-in-the-loop by design. Every recommendation has a clear source and an undo.

04

### Outcomes over optics.

Care gaps closed. Denials avoided. Hours given back. We measure what matters, in the chart, every visit — not in slide decks.
